title: You said five minutes… how many hours did it eat? #Shorts
description:
Every night it was five more minutes, and every night the thing in his window came closer: two hours, four, seven, eleven. Then the phone died, and the black glass showed what had been eating him.

Full film: https://youtu.be/4cDycr2W4p0
